matches.title: Turkey vs France
matches.description: Watch Turkey vs France highlights and goals from UEFA Nations League on ReFooty: Football Highlights Hub. Match played on September 25, 2026. The UEFA Nations League brought together two of Europe’s most passionate footballing nations for a high-stakes clash. On September 25, 2026 , the atmosphere was electric as both sides looked to establish dominance in a match defined by tactical discipline and sudden bursts of quality. Tactical Stalemate in the First Half The opening period was a cagey affair, with 28,205 fans witnessing a battle of wits in the midfield. Turkiye attempted to break the lines early on, but Baris Alper Yilmaz and Mehmet Zeki Celik were repeatedly caught by the French offside trap. On the other side, France struggled to find their rhythm, with Michael Olise also being ruled offside during a rare foray into the box. Arda Guler was the primary source of creativity for the hosts, delivering several dangerous corners that tested the French resolve. However, the first half ended without a breakthrough, highlighted more by defensive solidity than attacking flair. The tension boiled over just before the break when Guler received a yellow card for a reckless challenge, signaling the physical nature of the contest. Mbappé Provides the Spark The deadlock was finally broken in the 54th minute. Michael Olise turned provider, sliding a perfectly weighted pass to Kylian Mbappé , who made no mistake with a clinical right-footed finish. The goal shifted the momentum, forcing Turkiye to be more adventurous. Ismail Yuksek nearly leveled the score with a powerful header, but Mike Maignan was positioned perfectly to make the save. France came inches away from doubling their lead in the 69th minute when Jules Kounde saw his powerful effort strike the post. As the clock ticked down, Turkiye threw everything forward, including an audacious bicycle kick from Abdulkerim Bardakci that whistled just wide of the target, keeping the home crowd on the edge of their seats. Red Card Drama and Final Whistle The match reached a chaotic conclusion in the 87th minute. In a moment of madness, Turkish goalkeeper Ugurcan Cakir was shown a straight red card for handling the ball outside his area. This forced a tactical reshuffle, with Altay Bayindir coming on to replace the dismissed keeper, while France introduced Esteban Lepaul for his debut to see out the game. Despite the numerical disadvantage, Turkiye pushed for a late equalizer during eight minutes of stoppage time. Yellow cards were handed out to Manu Kone and Lepaul as tempers flared, but the French defense, led by Dayot Upamecano , held firm. With 64% possession, the visitors managed the final moments professionally to secure a hard-fought 1-0 victory.
